extracted.name: Easiest Mac-N-Cheese Ever!
extracted.description: Make homemade macaroni and cheese with elbow macaroni, cubed processed cheese, milk, and black pepper. This is the easiest mac-n-cheese recipe ever.
instruction_lines: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook elbow macaroni in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, 8 to 10 minutes; drain.
Place a saucepan over medium-low heat; add cheese, milk, and black pepper. Cook until cheese has melted, stirring frequently. Stir in drained macaroni until evenly coated.
